name: [TDD] Formatter - Compound Assignments
code:
//@version=6
indicator('Test')
a += 1
b -= 1
c *= 1
d /= 1
e + = 1
f - = 1
expectedFormattedCode:
//@version=6
indicator('Test')
a += 1
b -= 1
c *= 1
d /= 1
e += 1
f -= 1
description: Formatter should format compound assignments correctly and fix malformed compound operators.

name: [TDD] Formatter - Relational and Other Operators
code:
//@version=6
indicator('Test')
a= =b
c! =d
e> =f
g< =h
i: =j
k% =l
expectedFormattedCode:
//@version=6
indicator('Test')
a==b
c!=d
e>=f
g<=h
i:=j
k%=l
description: Formatter should format relational and assignment operators correctly and fix their malformed spaced versions.

name: Malformed function declaration operator (= >)
errorMessages: Invalid operator space, did you mean '=>'?
description: True positive (syntax error), but AST sees = as an assignment. The error message is confusing to the user who meant =>.

name: Malformed compound assignment operator (+ =)
errorMessages: Invalid operator space, did you mean '+='?
description: True positive (syntax error) for malformed compound assignment operator. Throws syntax error at input '='.

name: Malformed relational operators (= =, ! =, > =, < =, : =, % =)
code:
//@version=6
indicator('Test')
if a = = b
    x = 1
if c ! = d
    x = 2
if e > = f
    x = 3
if g < = h
    x = 4
i : = j
k % = l
errorMessages: Invalid operator space, did you mean '=='?
Invalid operator space, did you mean '!='?
Invalid operator space, did you mean '>='?
Invalid operator space, did you mean '<='?
Invalid operator space, did you mean ':='?
Invalid operator space, did you mean '%='?
description: Checks that the static checker properly catches spaced operators and emits the correct helpful message.

name: False Positive: '/=' inside line comment
description: Checks that the spaced operator validator ignores comments (e.g. '// =' being mistaken for a malformed '/=').

name: False Positive: '%=' inside line comment
description: Checks that the spaced operator validator ignores comments (e.g. '10% =' being mistaken for a malformed '%=').
